findingClass: a live (UPCOMING/OPEN) ipos row with zero field_sources rows at all — created outside consolidation, invisible to every per-field provenance check, never repaired
failThreshold: any UPCOMING/OPEN offering_type=IPO row with zero field_sources rows. This is the row-level sibling of m_live_ipo_has_state (document_fetch_state) — the only check that notices the machine wrote NOTHING for a row's provenance, ever
